# FastNoiseLite C++ reference input

The independent algorithm reference includes the unmodified FastNoiseLite 1.1.1 C++ header at `reference/fastnoiselite/FastNoiseLite.h`, from https://github.com/Auburn/FastNoiseLite/blob/v1.1.1/Cpp/FastNoiseLite.h.

SHA-256: `47a29750dfe13d15651febd235f3c26b1cc57af7c6e26583b838fd7ab5215dc2`.
